# Ray Template

> A Vue 3 + TypeScript/TSX admin template. The pnpm workspace contains the admin application, the VitePress documentation site, and shared packages.

Follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and select the entry point for the task. Read this index directly, or use `pnpm harness context <scope>` to display the same content and targeted verification commands.

## Task index

- [routing](harness/context/routing.md): Pages and menus, dynamic route JSON, view IDs, roles, and guards.
- [layout](harness/context/layout.md): Bootstrap, providers, navigation, KeepAlive, Pinia, and preference import/export.
- [ui](harness/context/ui.md): Shared components, pages and login, themes and bilingual copy, hooks, and directives.
- [table-pro](harness/context/table-pro.md): RTablePro, useTablePro, search, requests, column selection, export, and printing.
- [api](harness/context/api.md): Business APIs, Axios, AbortSignal, interceptors, mocks, and static data.
- [utils](harness/context/utils.md): Precision, files, storage, legacy AES formats, and application compatibility entry points.
- [icons](harness/context/icons.md): SVG groups, icon names, manifest generation, and hot updates.
- [docs](harness/context/docs.md): VitePress, API references, embedded examples, sidebars, and legacy redirects.
- [toolchain](harness/context/toolchain.md): Workspace dependencies, public exports, TypeScript, Vite, build artifacts, and CI.
- [harness](harness/context/harness.md): Index maintenance, regression targets, verification commands, and reports.

## Background when needed

- [Architecture map](docs/architecture.md): Workspace boundaries, runtime flows, type checking, and deployment.
- [AI Harness](harness/README.md): Verification workflow, browser verification, and local evidence.
